snippet.title: Gladio Mori  Release Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Mark the 16th of September in your calendar ⚔️

Get Gladio Mori:
► Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2689120/Gladio_Mori/
► PlayStation Store: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10017920
► XBOX: https://www.xbox.com/en-en/games/store/gladio-mori-demo/9mt0vww9d81m

Gladio Mori is a physics-driven multiplayer gladiator combat game featuring slow-motion battles, organ-specific damage, and a fully customizable move editor. Craft your own fighting style or use community created movesets to fight your way to glory.

GLADIO MORI SOCIALS
►Twitter: https://x.com/PlebeianStudio/
►Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/gladiomorigame/?hl=en
►TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@littlelegatus
►Discord: https://discord.gg/BV8gqwqZUV

#gladiomori #hema #physicsgame
